entries.title: Psalms 101:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

entries.title: Psalms 101:2
segments: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

entries.title: Psalms 101:3
segments: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; [it] shall not cleave to me. {wicked...: Heb. thing of Belial}

words.text: to me. {wicked...: Heb. thing of Belial}

entries.title: Psalms 101:4
segments: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked [person].

words.text: from me: I will not know

entries.title: Psalms 101:5
segments: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

entries.title: Psalms 101:6
segments: Mine eyes [shall be] upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me. {in a...: or, perfect in the way}

words.text: me. {in a...: or, perfect in the way}

entries.title: Psalms 101:7
segments: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight. {shall not tarry: Heb. shall not be established}

words.text: . {shall not tarry: Heb. shall not be established}

entries.title: Psalms 101:8
segments: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
